label: A news front
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Libre+Franklin:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,600;0,6..72,700;1,6..72,400&family=UnifrakturMaguntia&family=Anton&display=swap');
  /* A daily paper on a 78rem page: the edition bar, a blackletter nameplate with two ears, the section row between
     rules, the breaking ticker, the lead story beside the latest headlines, then the story rows. Serif headlines
     (Newsreader), a grotesque for everything around them (Libre Franklin), one red for the paper's voice. Looks:
     Broadsheet (newsprint, follows light / dark), Evening edition (navy and amber) and Tabloid (white, red, Anton). */
  #site-news {
    --background: oklch(0.968 0.006 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.17 0.008 80);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.004 85);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.925 0.008 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.43 0.012 80);
    --border: oklch(0.17 0.008 80 / 0.16);
    --input: oklch(0.17 0.008 80 / 0.28);
    --primary: oklch(0.5 0.18 27);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.004 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.925 0.008 85);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.925 0.008 85);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0rem;
    --radius-sm: 0rem;
    --radius-md: 0rem;
    --radius-lg: 0rem;
    --radius-xl: 0rem;
    --news-plate: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', var(--font-serif);
    --news-head: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
    --news-sans: 'Libre Franklin', var(--font-sans);
    --news-body: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
    --news-rule: var(--foreground);
    --news-ink: var(--primary);
    container-type: inline-size;
    color-scheme: light;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0 clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem) clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--news-sans);
  }
  #site-news > :not(dialog) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 78rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  .dark #site-news[data-look='broadsheet'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.19 0.006 80);
    --foreground: oklch(0.93 0.008 85);
    --card: oklch(0.22 0.006 80);
    --muted: oklch(0.26 0.008 80);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.72 0.012 85);
    --border: oklch(0.93 0.008 85 / 0.16);
    --input: oklch(0.93 0.008 85 / 0.28);
    --primary: oklch(0.68 0.17 27);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.16 0.006 80);
    --secondary: oklch(0.26 0.008 80);
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.008 80);
  }
  #site-news[data-look='evening'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.2 0.03 258);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.012 85);
    --card: oklch(0.235 0.032 258);
    --muted: oklch(0.27 0.032 258);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.025 250);
    --border: oklch(0.94 0.012 85 / 0.16);
    --input: oklch(0.94 0.012 85 / 0.3);
    --primary: oklch(0.8 0.13 75);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.03 258);
    --secondary: oklch(0.27 0.032 258);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.032 258);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-news[data-look='tabloid'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.995 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.13 0 0);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.38 0 0);
    --border: oklch(0.13 0 0 / 0.18);
    --primary: oklch(0.56 0.22 27);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.995 0 0);
    --news-plate: 'Anton', Impact, sans-serif;
    --news-head: 'Anton', Impact, sans-serif;
    --news-body: 'Libre Franklin', var(--font-sans);
    --news-ink: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-news [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* the edition bar (Site Header): the city edition and the paper's links on the left, the look, the language, the
     mode and Subscribe on the right - small print above the nameplate, no box */
  #site-news .mk-header.news-bar {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .mk-header-brand {
    gap: 1.5rem;
    color: inherit;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .mk-header-brand:hover .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .mk-header-nav {
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  /* narrow: the menu button sits at the end of the brand's row, the controls wrap below */
  #site-news .news-bar .site-menu {
    margin-inline-start: auto;
  }
  #site-news .sheet .mk-header-sheet-actions {
    display: grid;
    justify-content: stretch;
  }
  #site-news .news-menu .sheet-title {
    font-family: var(--news-plate);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .nav-menu-list {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .nav-menu-link {
    padding: 0.25rem 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 600 0.8125rem/1.2 var(--news-sans);
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .nav-menu-link:hover {
    background: none;
    color: var(--primary);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.3em;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    flex-shrink: 1;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .select {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 8.5rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-bar .news-subscribe {
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  /* the masthead: the folio line, the nameplate between its ears, the sections between rules */
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    column-gap: 2rem;
    row-gap: 0;
    max-width: 78rem;
    padding: 0;
    border-block-start: 3px solid var(--news-rule);
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] > :not(.news-ear, .mk-news-header-title) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-top {
    padding-block: 0.625rem;
    border-block: 0;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header-kicker {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-title {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 2;
    margin: 0;
    padding-block: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
    font-family: var(--news-plate);
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 7.5vw, 5.75rem);
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  /* the ears: weather and price, set like the paper's small print - no boxes */
  #site-news .news-ear {
    grid-row: 2;
    justify-self: start;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    max-width: 15rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline-start: 0.875rem;
    border-inline-start: 2px solid var(--news-ink);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-align: start;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-news .news-ear:last-of-type {
    grid-column: 3;
    justify-self: end;
    padding-inline: 0 0.875rem;
    border-inline: 0 2px solid var(--news-ink);
    text-align: end;
  }
  #site-news .news-ear b {
    font: 700 1.25rem/1.1 var(--news-head);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-topics {
    gap: 0.25rem 1.75rem;
    border-block: 1px solid var(--news-rule);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 -2px var(--news-rule);
    padding-block: 0.125rem 0.25rem;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-topics a {
    padding-block: 0.625rem;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-topics a[aria-current] {
    text-decoration: underline 2px var(--primary);
    text-underline-offset: 0.45em;
  }
  #site-news[data-look='tabloid'] .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-title {
    justify-self: center;
    padding: 0.12em 0.4em 0.08em;
    margin-block: 1.25rem;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  /* the ticker: a solid label, the headlines between hairlines */
  #site-news .mk-news-ticker {
    border: 0;
    border-block: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-ticker[data-variant='breaking'] .mk-news-ticker-label {
    padding-inline: 1rem;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-ticker-items a {
    color: inherit;
  }
  /* the front: the lead story beside the latest headlines and the numbers, a column rule between */
  #site-news .news-front {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  @container (width > 56rem) {
    #site-news .news-front {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.9fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 2.75rem;
    }
    #site-news .news-front > * + * {
      border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-inline-start: 2.75rem;
    }
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item {
    border-color: var(--border);
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item-category {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item-meta {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item-title {
    font-family: var(--news-head);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item-title a {
    color: inherit;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='lead'] {
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding-block-end: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='lead'] .mk-news-item-body {
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='lead'] .mk-news-item-title {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.2vw, 3.25rem);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.04;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='lead'] .mk-news-item-summary {
    max-width: 40rem;
    font: 400 clamp(1.0625rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem)/1.5 var(--news-body);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-byline {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-byline b {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #site-news[data-look='tabloid'] .mk-news-item-title {
    font-weight: 400;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.005em;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  /* the lead photo, screened in halftone - the paper's ink on the paper */
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='lead'] .mk-news-item-media {
    order: 1;
    aspect-ratio: auto;
    overflow: visible;
    background: none;
  }
  #site-news .news-screen {
    --shader-aspect: 16 / 9;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #site-news .news-credit {
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-align: end;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the column: section labels on a heavy rule */
  #site-news .news-label {
    margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
    padding-block-start: 0.625rem;
    border-block-start: 3px solid var(--news-rule);
    font: 800 0.75rem/1.2 var(--news-sans);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='compact'] .mk-news-item-title {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  #site-news .mk-news-item[data-variant='compact'] .mk-news-item-meta {
    min-width: 4.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #site-news .news-numbers {
    margin-block-start: 2rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-numbers dl {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 0.875rem 1rem;
    margin: 0.875rem 0 0;
    align-items: baseline;
  }
  #site-news .news-numbers dt {
    min-width: 3.5rem;
    font: 700 2rem/1 var(--news-head);
    color: var(--news-ink);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #site-news .news-numbers dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-news[data-look='tabloid'] .news-numbers dt {
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  /* the story rows below the fold */
  #site-news .news-stories {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 19rem), 1fr));
    gap: 0 2.5rem;
    padding-block-start: 0.25rem;
    border-block-start: 3px solid var(--news-rule);
  }
  #site-news .news-stories .mk-news-item {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.875rem;
    padding-block: 1.25rem;
    border: 0;
  }
  #site-news .news-stories .mk-news-item-media {
    order: -1;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
  }
  #site-news .news-stories .mk-news-item-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05);
  }
  #site-news[data-look='evening'] .news-stories .mk-news-item-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) sepia(0.45) hue-rotate(185deg) saturate(0.8);
  }
  #site-news .news-stories .mk-news-item-title {
    font-size: 1.375rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  #site-news .news-stories .mk-news-item-summary {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  @container (width < 44rem) {
    #site-news .news-ear {
      display: none;
    }
    #site-news .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-title {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      justify-self: center;
      white-space: normal;
      text-align: center;
    }
  }
  /* the story page: the masthead shrinks to the nameplate, the story reads in one column of Newsreader */
  #site-news[data-news-page='story'] :is(.news-ear, .mk-news-header-top) {
    display: none;
  }
  #site-news[data-news-page='story'] .mk-news-header[data-variant='masthead'] .mk-news-header-title {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 1;
    justify-self: center;
    padding-block: 0.875rem;
    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  }
  /* a section: its name large on the heavy rule, a line on what it covers, the stories as rows */
  #site-news .news-section {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-section-head {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-section-title {
    margin: 0;
    font: 700 clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem) / 1.04 var(--news-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-news[data-look='tabloid'] .news-section-title {
    font-weight: 400;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-news .news-section-dek {
    max-width: 40rem;
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 1.125rem/1.5 var(--news-body);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-section-list {
    display: grid;
    border-block-start: 3px solid var(--news-rule);
  }
  #site-news .news-section-list .mk-news-item {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem 2rem;
    padding-block: 1.5rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  @container (width > 40rem) {
    #site-news .news-section-list .mk-news-item {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 16rem);
      align-items: start;
    }
  }
  #site-news .news-section-list .mk-news-item-media {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
  }
  #site-news .news-section-list .mk-news-item-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05);
  }
  #site-news[data-look='evening'] .news-section-list .mk-news-item-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) sepia(0.45) hue-rotate(185deg) saturate(0.8);
  }
  #site-news .news-section-list .mk-news-item-title {
    font-size: 1.625rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }
  #site-news .news-section-list .mk-news-item-summary {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-story {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-story-column {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 44rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  #site-news .news-story-back {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
    margin: 0 auto -1rem;
    font: 700 0.75rem/1.2 var(--news-sans);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-news .news-story-back a {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-news .news-story-back a:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-news .news-story-back svg {
    width: 0.875rem;
    height: 0.875rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header {
    max-width: none;
    padding: 0;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header > :not(figure) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 44rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-category {
    color: var(--primary);
    font: 800 0.75rem/1.2 var(--news-sans);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-title {
    font: 700 clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.75rem)/1.04 var(--news-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-news[data-look='tabloid'] .news-story .mk-article-header-title {
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0.005em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-subtitle {
    font: 400 clamp(1.125rem, 1.8vw, 1.375rem)/1.45 var(--news-body);
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-byline {
    margin-block-start: 0.25rem;
    padding-block: 0.875rem;
    border-block: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-media {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 62rem;
    margin: 0.75rem auto 0;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-media img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    object-fit: cover;
    filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05);
  }
  #site-news[data-look='evening'] .news-story .mk-article-header-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) sepia(0.45) hue-rotate(185deg) saturate(0.8);
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-header-media figcaption {
    margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-align: end;
  }
  #site-news .news-story .mk-article-body {
    --_measure: 40rem;
    padding: 0;
